paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah, chapter 1, beginning of section 11; R' Yudan reports in his name.[^1]

notes.text: Both personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. רפ״יא is read conventionally as beginning of section 11, superseding the older end reading; no modern verse conversion or exact edition mapping has been verified. In his name contextually points to the heading subject Shimon, without an independently bound authority identity. Shakfa is retained without normalizing its vocalization.
